build_levit_backbone: build a LeViT backbone model with forward hooks on specified block indices
run_forward_levit: run a forward pass through the LeViT model and extract three post-processed activation layers
create_ConvTransposeNorm: create a ConvTranspose2d and BatchNorm2d sequential module with optional weight fusion

create_pretrained_levit_384: create a pretrained LeViT-384 model adapter wrapped as a backbone with hooks
